int position_of<T>(const T[] values, T value)
    for index := values.indices()[]
        if values[index] == value
            return int(index)
    return -1

string[] directions()
    return ["north", "south", "east", "west", "up", "down"]

int direction_index(string word)
    names := directions()
    for index := names.indices()[]
        if word == names[index] or word == names[index][0]
            return int(index)
    return -1

string[] command_words(string line)
    lowered := ""
    int[] points := line.codepoints()
    for index := points.indices()[]
        point := points[index]
        lowered += if 65 <= point <= 90 then "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"[point - 65] else line[index]
    return [for word := lowered.split(" ")[] if word != "" and word != "the" and word != "a" and word != "an" then word]

bool all_form(const string[] phrase)
    return phrase == ["all"]

enum PlaceKind
    Nowhere
    Floor
    Player
    Inside

class Place(PlaceKind kind, index := -1)

enum ContainerState
    Open
    Closed
    Locked

string container_text(ContainerState state)
    match state
        ContainerState.Open
            return "open"
        ContainerState.Closed
            return "closed"
        ContainerState.Locked
            return "locked"

enum EndStatus
    Playing
    Won
    Dead

class Exit(destination := -1, key := -1, locked := false)
class Room(name := "", dark := false, string[] description := [])
class Item(name := "", weight := 0, treasure := 0, light := false, capacity := 0, key := -1, fixed := false)
    string[] nouns := []
    string[] name_words := []
    string[] details := []

enum TriggerKind
    Enter
    Use

class Trigger(TriggerKind kind, int first, second := -1)
class Condition(string flag, bool expected)
class MessageEffect(string text)
class OpenEffect(int room, int direction, int destination)
class MoveEffect(int item, Place place)
class FlagEffect(string flag, bool on)
class PointsEffect(int points)
class Rule(Trigger trigger, Condition | none condition, MessageEffect | OpenEffect | MoveEffect | FlagEffect | PointsEffect effect)

class World(Room[] rooms, Item[] items, Rule[] rules, distinct<string> vocabulary, int trophy, int max_weight)
class State(int room, Place[] places, ContainerState[] containers, bool[] lit, int[] fuel, Exit[][] exits, bool[] visited)
    flags := distinct<string>()
    bonus := 0
    moves := 0
    darkness := 0
    EndStatus ended := EndStatus.Playing

class Adventure(World world, State state)
    State | none saved := none
    pronoun := -1
    previous := ""
    verbose := false
    string[] output := []

Rule read_rule(const string[] words, int start, Trigger trigger, const string[] room_ids, const string[] item_ids)
    at := start
    Condition | none condition := none
    if words[at] == "IF" or words[at] == "UNLESS"
        condition = Condition(words[at + 1], words[at] == "IF")
        at += 2
    MessageEffect | OpenEffect | MoveEffect | FlagEffect | PointsEffect effect
    if words[at] == "MESSAGE"
        effect = MessageEffect(words[at + 1:].join(" "))
    elif words[at] == "OPEN"
        effect = OpenEffect(position_of(room_ids, words[at + 1]), direction_index(words[at + 2]), position_of(room_ids, words[at + 3]))
    elif words[at] == "REMOVE"
        effect = MoveEffect(position_of(item_ids, words[at + 1]), Place(PlaceKind.Nowhere))
    elif words[at] == "ADD"
        effect = MoveEffect(position_of(item_ids, words[at + 1]), Place(PlaceKind.Floor, position_of(room_ids, words[at + 2])))
    elif words[at] == "SET" or words[at] == "CLEAR"
        effect = FlagEffect(words[at + 1], words[at] == "SET")
    else
        effect = PointsEffect(int(words[at + 1]))
    return Rule(trigger, condition, effect)

Adventure read_world(const string[][] definitions)
    room_ids := [for words := definitions[] if words[0] == "ROOM" then words[1]]
    item_ids := [for words := definitions[] if words[0] == "ITEM" then words[1]].sorted()
    rooms := array(#room_ids, fill = Room())
    items := array(#item_ids, fill = Item())
    for index := item_ids.indices()[]
        items[index].nouns = [item_ids[index]]
    state := State(0, array(#item_ids, fill = Place(PlaceKind.Nowhere)), array(#item_ids, fill = ContainerState.Open), array(#item_ids, fill = false), array(#item_ids, fill = 0), array(#room_ids, fill = array(6, fill = Exit())), array(#room_ids, fill = false))
    Rule[] rules := []
    trophy := 0
    max_weight := 0
    for words := definitions[]
        command := words[0]
        if command == "ROOM"
            index := position_of(room_ids, words[1])
            dark := words[2] == "DARK"
            start := if dark then 3 else 2
            rooms[index].dark = dark
            rooms[index].name = words[start:].join(" ")
        elif command == "DESC"
            index := position_of(room_ids, words[1])
            rooms[index].description = rooms[index].description.append(words[2:].join(" "))
        elif command == "EXIT"
            room := position_of(room_ids, words[1])
            direction := direction_index(words[2])
            locked := #words > 4
            key := if locked then position_of(item_ids, words[5]) else -1
            state.exits[room][direction] = Exit(position_of(room_ids, words[3]), key, locked)
        elif command == "ITEM"
            index := position_of(item_ids, words[1])
            if words[2] == "PLAYER"
                state.places[index] = Place(PlaceKind.Player)
            elif words[2] == "NOWHERE"
                state.places[index] = Place(PlaceKind.Nowhere)
            else
                state.places[index] = Place(PlaceKind.Floor, position_of(room_ids, words[2]))
            item := items[index]
            item.weight = int(words[3])
            at := 4
            if words[at] == "TREASURE"
                item.treasure = int(words[at + 1])
                at += 2
            if words[at] == "LIGHT"
                item.light = true
                state.fuel[index] = int(words[at + 1])
                at += 2
            if words[at] == "CONTAINER"
                item.capacity = int(words[at + 1])
                at += 2
                if words[at] == "CLOSED"
                    state.containers[index] = ContainerState.Closed
                    at += 1
                if words[at] == "LOCKED"
                    item.key = position_of(item_ids, words[at + 1])
                    state.containers[index] = ContainerState.Locked
                    at += 2
            if words[at] == "FIXED"
                item.fixed = true
                at += 1
            item.name = words[at:].join(" ")
            item.name_words = words[at:]
            items[index] = item
        elif command == "INSIDE"
            state.places[position_of(item_ids, words[1])] = Place(PlaceKind.Inside, position_of(item_ids, words[2]))
        elif command == "ALIAS"
            index := position_of(item_ids, words[1])
            items[index].nouns = items[index].nouns.append(words[2])
        elif command == "DETAIL"
            index := position_of(item_ids, words[1])
            items[index].details = items[index].details.append(words[2:].join(" "))
        elif command == "RULE"
            rules = rules.append(read_rule(words, 3, Trigger(TriggerKind.Use, position_of(item_ids, words[1]), position_of(item_ids, words[2])), room_ids, item_ids))
        elif command == "ENTER"
            rules = rules.append(read_rule(words, 2, Trigger(TriggerKind.Enter, position_of(room_ids, words[1])), room_ids, item_ids))
        elif command == "TROPHY"
            trophy = position_of(room_ids, words[1])
        elif command == "START"
            state.room = position_of(room_ids, words[1])
        elif command == "MAXWEIGHT"
            max_weight = int(words[1])
    state.visited[state.room] = true
    distinct<string> vocabulary
    for item := items[]
        for word := item.nouns.concat(item.name_words)[]
            .vocabulary.add(word)
    return Adventure(World(rooms, items, rules, vocabulary, trophy, max_weight), state)

void say(Adventure &game, string text)
    game.output = game.output.append(text)

Place room_floor(const Adventure game)
    return Place(PlaceKind.Floor, game.state.room)

int[] direct_items(const Adventure game, Place place)
    return [for index := game.state.places.indices()[] if game.state.places[index] == place then int(index)]

bool reachable(const Adventure game, int item, Place root)
    place := game.state.places[item]
    while place.kind == PlaceKind.Inside
        if game.state.containers[place.index] != ContainerState.Open
            return false
        place = game.state.places[place.index]
    return place == root

bool carried(const Adventure game, int item)
    return reachable(game, item, Place(PlaceKind.Player))

bool room_item(const Adventure game, int item)
    return reachable(game, item, room_floor(game))

bool is_lit(const Adventure game)
    if not game.world.rooms[game.state.room].dark
        return true
    for index := game.world.items.indices()[]
        if game.state.lit[index] and (carried(game, int(index)) or room_item(game, int(index)))
            return true
    return false

int total_weight(const Adventure game, int item)
    contents := [for child := direct_items(game, Place(PlaceKind.Inside, item))[] then total_weight(game, child)]
    return game.world.items[item].weight + contents.sum()

int place_weight(const Adventure game, Place place)
    return [for item := direct_items(game, place)[] then total_weight(game, item)].sum()

bool within(const Adventure game, int item, int ancestor)
    place := game.state.places[item]
    while place.kind == PlaceKind.Inside
        if place.index == ancestor
            return true
        place = game.state.places[place.index]
    return false

bool stored(const Adventure game, int item)
    place := game.state.places[item]
    while place.kind == PlaceKind.Inside
        place = game.state.places[place.index]
    return place == Place(PlaceKind.Floor, game.world.trophy)

(int, int, int) treasures(const Adventure game)
    all := [for index := game.world.items.indices()[] if game.world.items[index].treasure > 0 then int(index)]
    present := [for item := all[] if stored(game, item) then item]
    return ([for item := present[] then game.world.items[item].treasure].sum(), int(#present), int(#all))

int score_value(const Adventure game)
    points, _, _ := treasures(game)
    return points + game.state.bonus

string display_name(const Adventure game, int item)
    string[] annotations := []
    if game.world.items[item].capacity > 0
        annotations = annotations.append(container_text(game.state.containers[item]))
    if game.state.lit[item]
        annotations = annotations.append("lit")
    return game.world.items[item].name + (if #annotations == 0 then "" else " (" + annotations.join(", ") + ")")

void item_tree(Adventure &game, Place place, int depth)
    for item := direct_items(game, place)[]
        say(&game, " " * nat(depth * 2) + display_name(game, item))
        if game.world.items[item].capacity > 0 and game.state.containers[item] == ContainerState.Open
            item_tree(&game, Place(PlaceKind.Inside, item), depth + 1)

void describe(Adventure &game, bool full)
    if not is_lit(game)
        say(&game, "It is pitch dark.")
        return
    room := game.world.rooms[game.state.room]
    say(&game, room.name)
    if full
        game.output = game.output.concat(room.description)
    string[] exits := []
    for: 0 <= direction < 6
        exit := game.state.exits[game.state.room][direction]
        if exit.destination >= 0
            exits = exits.append(directions()[direction] + (if exit.locked then " (locked)" else ""))
    say(&game, "Exits: " + (if #exits == 0 then "none" else exits.join(", ")))
    if #direct_items(game, room_floor(game)) > 0
        say(&game, "You see:")
        item_tree(&game, room_floor(game), 1)

int | error resolve(Adventure &game, const string[] phrase)
    lit := is_lit(game)
    if phrase == ["it"]
        item := game.pronoun
        if item < 0
            return error("I don't know what {DQ}it{DQ} refers to.")
        if not carried(game, item) and not (lit and room_item(game, item))
            return error("You can't see any such thing.")
        return item
    for word := phrase[]
        if not game.world.vocabulary.has(word)
            return error("I don't know the word {DQ}{word}{DQ}.")
    int[] matches := []
    for index := game.world.items.indices()[]
        item := int(index)
        if not carried(game, item) and not (lit and room_item(game, item))
            continue
        definition := game.world.items[item]
        if position_of(definition.nouns, phrase[-1]) < 0
            continue
        matches_all := true
        for adjective := phrase[0:<int(#phrase) - 1][]
            if position_of(definition.name_words, adjective) < 0
                matches_all = false
        if matches_all
            matches = matches.append(item)
    if #matches == 0
        return error("You can't see any such thing.")
    if #matches > 1
        names := [for item := matches[] then game.world.items[item].name].join(", ")
        return error("Which do you mean: " + names + "?")
    game.pronoun = matches[0]
    return matches[0]

bool condition_holds(const State state, Condition | none condition)
    match condition
        Condition value
            return state.flags.has(value.flag) == value.expected
        none
            return true

(int, bool) run_rules(Adventure &game, Trigger trigger)
    executed := 0
    message := false
    for rule := game.world.rules[]
        if rule.trigger != trigger or not condition_holds(game.state, rule.condition)
            continue
        executed += 1
        match rule.effect
            MessageEffect effect
                say(&game, effect.text)
                message = true
            OpenEffect effect
                game.state.exits[effect.room][effect.direction] = Exit(effect.destination)
            MoveEffect effect
                game.state.places[effect.item] = effect.place
            FlagEffect effect
                if effect.on
                    .game.state.flags.add(effect.flag)
                else
                    .game.state.flags.remove(effect.flag)
            PointsEffect effect
                game.state.bonus += effect.points
    return (executed, message)

void pass_turn(Adventure &game, bool baseline)
    game.state.moves += 1
    nearby := [for index := game.world.items.indices()[] then carried(game, int(index)) or room_item(game, int(index))]
    for index := game.world.items.indices()[]
        if game.state.lit[index]
            game.state.fuel[index] -= 1
            if game.state.fuel[index] == 0
                game.state.lit[index] = false
                if nearby[index]
                    say(&game, "The {game.world.items[index].name} goes out.")
    lit := is_lit(game)
    if baseline and not lit
        say(&game, "It is now pitch dark.")
    elif not baseline and lit
        describe(&game, true)
    game.state.darkness = if lit then 0 else game.state.darkness + 1
    if game.state.darkness == 2
        say(&game, "You hear something moving in the dark.")
    if game.state.darkness == 3
        game.state.ended = EndStatus.Dead
    points, count, total := treasures(game)
    if game.state.ended == EndStatus.Playing and total > 0 and count == total
        game.state.ended = EndStatus.Won
    if game.state.ended != EndStatus.Playing
        say(&game, if game.state.ended == EndStatus.Dead then "*** You have died ***" else "*** You have won ***")
        say(&game, "You scored {points + game.state.bonus} points in {game.state.moves} moves.")

void | error require_container(const Adventure game, int item)
    if game.world.items[item].capacity == 0
        return error("The {game.world.items[item].name} is not a container.")
    if game.state.containers[item] != ContainerState.Open
        return error("The {game.world.items[item].name} is closed.")
    return void

string put_item(Adventure &game, int item, int container)
    if within(game, container, item)
        return "The {game.world.items[container].name} is inside the {game.world.items[item].name}."
    if game.state.places[item] == Place(PlaceKind.Inside, container)
        return "The {game.world.items[item].name} is already in the {game.world.items[container].name}."
    weight := place_weight(game, Place(PlaceKind.Inside, container))
    if not within(game, item, container)
        weight += total_weight(game, item)
    if weight > game.world.items[container].capacity
        return "The {game.world.items[item].name} doesn't fit in the {game.world.items[container].name}."
    game.state.places[item] = Place(PlaceKind.Inside, container)
    return ""

bool | error take_items(Adventure &game, const string[] target, const string[] from_phrase)
    if not is_lit(game)
        return error("It is pitch dark.")
    container := -1
    source := room_floor(game)
    if #from_phrase > 0
        container = try resolve(&game, from_phrase)
        try require_container(game, container)
        source = Place(PlaceKind.Inside, container)
    if all_form(target)
        candidates := [for item := direct_items(game, source)[] if not game.world.items[item].fixed then item]
        if #candidates == 0
            return error(if container < 0 then "There is nothing here to take." else "There is nothing in the {game.world.items[container].name} to take.")
        taken := false
        for item := candidates[]
            if not carried(game, item) and place_weight(game, Place(PlaceKind.Player)) + total_weight(game, item) > game.world.max_weight
                say(&game, "{game.world.items[item].name}: You can't carry any more.")
            else
                game.state.places[item] = Place(PlaceKind.Player)
                say(&game, "{game.world.items[item].name}: Taken.")
                taken = true
        return taken
    item := try resolve(&game, target)
    if container >= 0 and game.state.places[item] != source
        return error("The {game.world.items[item].name} is not in the {game.world.items[container].name}.")
    if game.state.places[item] == Place(PlaceKind.Player)
        return error("You already have the {game.world.items[item].name}.")
    if game.world.items[item].fixed
        return error("The {game.world.items[item].name} is fixed in place.")
    if not carried(game, item) and place_weight(game, Place(PlaceKind.Player)) + total_weight(game, item) > game.world.max_weight
        return error("You can't carry any more.")
    game.state.places[item] = Place(PlaceKind.Player)
    say(&game, "Taken.")
    return true

void | error drop_items(Adventure &game, const string[] target)
    if all_form(target)
        candidates := direct_items(game, Place(PlaceKind.Player))
        if #candidates == 0
            return error("You are empty-handed.")
        for item := candidates[]
            game.state.places[item] = room_floor(game)
            say(&game, "{game.world.items[item].name}: Dropped.")
    else
        item := try resolve(&game, target)
        if not carried(game, item)
            return error("You aren't carrying the {game.world.items[item].name}.")
        game.state.places[item] = room_floor(game)
        say(&game, "Dropped.")
    return void

bool | error put_items(Adventure &game, const string[] first, const string[] second)
    item := -1
    if not all_form(first)
        item = try resolve(&game, first)
    container := try resolve(&game, second)
    if item >= 0
        if not carried(game, item)
            return error("You aren't carrying the {game.world.items[item].name}.")
        if item == container
            return error("You can't put the {game.world.items[item].name} inside itself.")
    try require_container(game, container)
    if item >= 0
        reason := put_item(&game, item, container)
        if reason != ""
            return error(reason)
        say(&game, "You put the {game.world.items[item].name} in the {game.world.items[container].name}.")
        return true
    candidates := [for candidate := direct_items(game, Place(PlaceKind.Player))[] if candidate != container then candidate]
    if #candidates == 0
        return error("You have nothing to put in the {game.world.items[container].name}.")
    moved := false
    for candidate := candidates[]
        reason := put_item(&game, candidate, container)
        if reason == ""
            moved = true
            reason = "Done."
        say(&game, "{game.world.items[candidate].name}: {reason}")
    return moved

void | error key_check(Adventure &game, int key, const string[] phrase)
    if #phrase > 0
        item := try resolve(&game, phrase)
        if not carried(game, item)
            return error("You aren't carrying the {game.world.items[item].name}.")
        if item != key
            return error("The {game.world.items[item].name} doesn't fit.")
    else
        if not carried(game, key)
            return error("You don't have the right key.")
        say(&game, "(with the {game.world.items[key].name})")
    return void

void | error change_lock(Adventure &game, const string[] target, const string[] key_phrase, bool locking)
    direction := if #target == 1 then direction_index(target[0]) else -1
    status := if locking then "already locked" else "not locked"
    if direction >= 0
        exit := game.state.exits[game.state.room][direction]
        if exit.destination < 0
            return error("There is no exit " + directions()[direction] + ".")
        if exit.key < 0
            return error("The way " + directions()[direction] + " has no lock.")
        if exit.locked == locking
            return error("The way " + directions()[direction] + " is {status}.")
        try key_check(&game, exit.key, key_phrase)
        game.state.exits[game.state.room][direction].locked = locking
        reverse := direction + 1 - 2 * (direction % 2)
        opposite := game.state.exits[exit.destination][reverse]
        if opposite.destination == game.state.room and opposite.key == exit.key
            game.state.exits[exit.destination][reverse].locked = locking
    else
        item := try resolve(&game, target)
        if game.world.items[item].capacity == 0 or game.world.items[item].key < 0
            return error("The {game.world.items[item].name} has no lock.")
        if (game.state.containers[item] == ContainerState.Locked) == locking
            return error("The {game.world.items[item].name} is {status}.")
        if locking and game.state.containers[item] == ContainerState.Open
            return error("You must close the {game.world.items[item].name} first.")
        try key_check(&game, game.world.items[item].key, key_phrase)
        game.state.containers[item] = if locking then ContainerState.Locked else ContainerState.Closed
    say(&game, if locking then "Locked." else "Unlocked.")
    return void

void examine_item(Adventure &game, int item)
    definition := game.world.items[item]
    if #definition.details == 0
        say(&game, "You see nothing special about the {definition.name}.")
    else
        game.output = game.output.concat(definition.details)
    if definition.light
        status := if game.state.lit[item] then "lit" else "unlit"
        say(&game, "It is {status} (fuel {game.state.fuel[item]}).")
    if definition.capacity > 0
        if game.state.containers[item] == ContainerState.Locked
            say(&game, "It is locked.")
        elif game.state.containers[item] == ContainerState.Closed
            say(&game, "It is closed.")
        elif #direct_items(game, Place(PlaceKind.Inside, item)) == 0
            say(&game, "It is empty.")
        else
            say(&game, "It contains:")
            item_tree(&game, Place(PlaceKind.Inside, item), 1)
    if definition.treasure > 0
        say(&game, "It is a treasure worth {definition.treasure} points.")
    say(&game, "It weighs " + string(total_weight(game, item)) + ".")

enum Verb
    Go
    Look
    Examine
    Take
    Drop
    Put
    Inventory
    Open
    Close
    Unlock
    Lock
    Use
    Light
    Extinguish
    Wait
    Score
    Save
    Restore
    Verbose
    Brief

Verb[] verb_list()
    return [Verb.Go, Verb.Look, Verb.Examine, Verb.Take, Verb.Drop, Verb.Put, Verb.Inventory, Verb.Open, Verb.Close, Verb.Unlock, Verb.Lock, Verb.Use, Verb.Light, Verb.Extinguish, Verb.Wait, Verb.Score, Verb.Save, Verb.Restore, Verb.Verbose, Verb.Brief]

string verb_name(Verb kind)
    names := "go look examine take drop put inventory open close unlock lock use light extinguish wait score save restore verbose brief".split(" ")
    return names[position_of(verb_list(), kind)]

Verb | none parse_verb(string word)
    groups := ["go walk run", "look l", "examine x inspect read", "take get grab", "drop discard", "put insert place", "inventory inv i", "open", "close shut", "unlock", "lock", "use apply", "light ignite", "extinguish douse snuff", "wait z", "score", "save", "restore load", "verbose", "brief"]
    for index := groups.indices()[]
        if position_of(groups[index].split(" "), word) >= 0
            return verb_list()[index]
    return none

bool no_arguments(Verb kind)
    return position_of([Verb.Look, Verb.Inventory, Verb.Wait, Verb.Score, Verb.Save, Verb.Restore, Verb.Verbose, Verb.Brief], kind) >= 0

bool time_action(Verb kind)
    return position_of([Verb.Go, Verb.Take, Verb.Drop, Verb.Put, Verb.Open, Verb.Close, Verb.Unlock, Verb.Lock, Verb.Use, Verb.Light, Verb.Extinguish, Verb.Wait], kind) >= 0

bool | error perform(Adventure &game, Verb kind, const string[] first, const string[] second, int direction, bool &baseline)
    match kind
        Verb.Go
            exit := game.state.exits[game.state.room][direction]
            if exit.destination < 0
                return error("You can't go that way.")
            if exit.locked
                return error("The way " + directions()[direction] + " is locked.")
            game.state.room = exit.destination
            baseline = is_lit(game)
            describe(&game, game.verbose or not game.state.visited[game.state.room])
            game.state.visited[game.state.room] = true
            run_rules(&game, Trigger(TriggerKind.Enter, game.state.room))
        Verb.Look
            describe(&game, true)
        Verb.Examine
            item := try resolve(&game, first)
            examine_item(&game, item)
        Verb.Take
            return try take_items(&game, first, second)
        Verb.Drop
            try drop_items(&game, first)
        Verb.Put
            return try put_items(&game, first, second)
        Verb.Inventory
            if #direct_items(game, Place(PlaceKind.Player)) == 0
                say(&game, "You are empty-handed.")
            else
                say(&game, "You are carrying:")
                item_tree(&game, Place(PlaceKind.Player), 1)
                say(&game, "Total weight: " + string(place_weight(game, Place(PlaceKind.Player))) + "/{game.world.max_weight}")
        Verb.Open
            item := try resolve(&game, first)
            if game.world.items[item].capacity == 0
                return error("You can't open the {game.world.items[item].name}.")
            if game.state.containers[item] == ContainerState.Open
                return error("The {game.world.items[item].name} is already open.")
            if game.state.containers[item] == ContainerState.Locked
                return error("The {game.world.items[item].name} is locked.")
            game.state.containers[item] = ContainerState.Open
            children := direct_items(game, Place(PlaceKind.Inside, item))
            if #children == 0
                say(&game, "Opened.")
            else
                names := [for child := children[] then game.world.items[child].name].join(", ")
                say(&game, "Opening the {game.world.items[item].name} reveals {names}.")
        Verb.Close
            item := try resolve(&game, first)
            if game.world.items[item].capacity == 0
                return error("You can't close the {game.world.items[item].name}.")
            if game.state.containers[item] != ContainerState.Open
                return error("The {game.world.items[item].name} is already closed.")
            game.state.containers[item] = ContainerState.Closed
            say(&game, "Closed.")
        Verb.Unlock
            try change_lock(&game, first, second, false)
        Verb.Lock
            try change_lock(&game, first, second, true)
        Verb.Use
            a := try resolve(&game, first)
            b := try resolve(&game, second)
            if not carried(game, a)
                return error("You aren't carrying the {game.world.items[a].name}.")
            executed, message := run_rules(&game, Trigger(TriggerKind.Use, a, b))
            if executed == 0
                return error("Nothing happens.")
            if not message
                say(&game, "Done.")
        Verb.Light
            item := try resolve(&game, first)
            if not game.world.items[item].light
                return error("You can't light the {game.world.items[item].name}.")
            if game.state.lit[item]
                return error("The {game.world.items[item].name} is already lit.")
            if game.state.fuel[item] == 0
                return error("The {game.world.items[item].name} has no fuel.")
            game.state.lit[item] = true
            say(&game, "The {game.world.items[item].name} is now lit.")
        Verb.Extinguish
            item := try resolve(&game, first)
            if not game.world.items[item].light
                return error("You can't extinguish the {game.world.items[item].name}.")
            if not game.state.lit[item]
                return error("The {game.world.items[item].name} is not lit.")
            game.state.lit[item] = false
            say(&game, "The {game.world.items[item].name} is now out.")
        Verb.Wait
            say(&game, "Time passes.")
        Verb.Score
            points, count, total := treasures(game)
            say(&game, "You have scored {points + game.state.bonus} points (treasure {points}, bonus {game.state.bonus}) in {game.state.moves} moves.")
            say(&game, "Treasures stored: {count} of {total}.")
        Verb.Save
            game.saved = game.state
            say(&game, "Game saved.")
        Verb.Restore
            match game.saved
                State snapshot
                    game.state = snapshot
                none
                    return error("There is no saved game.")
            say(&game, "Game restored.")
            describe(&game, true)
        Verb.Verbose
            game.verbose = true
            say(&game, "Verbose mode.")
        Verb.Brief
            game.verbose = false
            say(&game, "Brief mode.")
    return true

void | error interpret(Adventure &game, string line)
    words := command_words(line)
    if #words == 0
        return error("I beg your pardon?")
    if direction_index(words[0]) >= 0
        words = ["go"].concat(words)
    Verb kind
    match parse_verb(words[0])
        Verb value
            kind = value
        none
            return error("I don't know the verb {DQ}{words[0]}{DQ}.")
    if game.state.ended != EndStatus.Playing and kind != Verb.Restore
        return error("The game is over.")
    first := words[1:]
    string[] second := []
    direction := -1
    if kind == Verb.Look and #first > 0
        if first[0] != "at"
            return error("I don't understand that.")
        kind = Verb.Examine
        first = first[1:]
    if no_arguments(kind)
        if #first > 0
            return error("I don't understand that.")
    else
        if #first == 0
            return error(if kind == Verb.Go then "Which way do you want to go?" else "What do you want to " + verb_name(kind) + "?")
        if kind == Verb.Go
            direction = if #first == 1 then direction_index(first[0]) else -1
            if direction < 0
                return error("I don't understand that.")
        else
            string[] prepositions := []
            if kind == Verb.Put
                prepositions = ["in", "into"]
            elif kind == Verb.Use
                prepositions = ["on", "with"]
            elif kind == Verb.Unlock or kind == Verb.Lock
                prepositions = ["with"]
            elif kind == Verb.Take
                prepositions = ["from"]
            split := -1
            for index := first.indices()[]
                if position_of(prepositions, first[index]) >= 0
                    split = int(index)
                    break
            if split >= 0
                if split == 0 or split + 1 == int(#first)
                    return error("I don't understand that.")
                second = first[split + 1:]
                first = first[0:<split]
            elif kind == Verb.Put or kind == Verb.Use
                return error("I don't understand that.")
    baseline := is_lit(game)
    succeeded := try perform(&game, kind, first, second, direction, &baseline)
    if succeeded and time_action(kind)
        pass_turn(&game, baseline)
    return void

void | error process_line(Adventure &game, string line)
    words := command_words(line)
    if #words > 0 and (words[0] == "again" or words[0] == "g")
        if #words > 1
            return error("I don't understand that.")
        if game.previous == ""
            return error("There is nothing to repeat.")
        try interpret(&game, game.previous)
    else
        game.previous = line
        try interpret(&game, line)
    return void

string[][] definitions := []
while true
    string line
    scan(&line)
    if line == "BEGIN"
        break
    definitions = definitions.append(line.split(" "))
game := read_world(definitions)
describe(&game, true)
for row := game.output[]
    println(row)
while true
    string line
    scan(&line)
    if line == "QUIT"
        break
    game.output = ["> " + line]
    match process_line(&game, line)
        void
            println(game.output.join(NL))
        error problem
            println(game.output.append(problem.message).join(NL))
println("Final score: " + string(score_value(game)) + " points in {game.state.moves} moves.")
